Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RTRMH Delhi Junior Resident (BDS) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for RTRMH Delhi Junior Resident (BDS) recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 20 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the essential qualifications required for the Junior Resident (BDS) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BDS degree from a recognized University, have completed their internship not more than 02 years ago, and be registered with the Delhi Dental Council or any State Dental Council.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident (BDS) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Government Rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident (BDS) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Resident (BDS) position announced by Rao Tula Ram Memorial Hospital.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Resident (BDS) role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Junior Resident (BDS) position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Ad-hoc.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Rao Tula Ram Memorial Hospital, New Delhi - 110073.
